label: Video monitoring
title: Video monitoring and analysis.
intro: Frame and focus your shot, compare sources in Reference Mode, and analyze exposure and color with professional scopes. Preview the look with LUTs and image adjustments.
summary: Compare live sources in Reference Mode. New exposure and color tools, expanded false color, and rebuilt focus peaking.

lead.title: Two live video sources. One workspace.
lead.copy: Two live inputs run simultaneously on iPad or Mac. Reference Mode displays both pictures side by side, with a wipe, or as an overlay for camera matching and continuity checks.

slides.title: Two live video sources
slides.caption: Monitor both live pictures together for camera matching and shot comparison.

lead.label: Explore video sources

cards.title: Framing, focus, and exposure
cards.copy: Compare framing crops side by side and check focus with peaking. Measure exposure and contrast with the Spot Meter, or use false color to assess skin tones and highlights.

slides.title: Spot Meter
slides.caption: Read exposure at two points in the image and see the contrast ratio between them.

slides.title: Custom false-color gradients
slides.caption: Set the colors and IRE ranges in your false-color scale.

slides.title: Framing crops
slides.caption: Compare widescreen and vertical crops of the same source.

slides.title: Focus peaking
slides.caption: Colored edges highlight fine detail for checking focus.

cards.label: Explore video assist tools

cards.title: Video scopes and image processing
cards.copy: Inspect the signal with video scopes and color palette analysis. Calibrate sources with Input Profiles, preview LUTs, and check composites and stereoscopic footage with the Color Keyer and 3D Preview.

slides.title: Video scopes
slides.caption: Compare waveform, vectorscope, and histogram views in one layout.

slides.title: Input Profiles
slides.caption: Set each source's gamma, gamut, and color space transform once, then reuse it.

slides.title: Color Palette
slides.caption: See the dominant colors and each color's share of the frame.

slides.title: Color Keyer
slides.caption: Inspect a keyed subject against transparency and a reference background.

slides.title: Anaglyph preview
slides.caption: Preview stereoscopic depth using red/cyan anaglyph glasses.

cards.label: Explore video monitoring

label: Audio monitoring
title: Audio mixing and analysis.
intro: Combine multiple audio sources in a single mix, with six audio scopes for monitoring levels, loudness, stereo phase, and frequency content.
summary: Multi-source audio mixing, six audio scopes, and BS.1770 loudness metering.

lead.title: Multi-source audio mixing
lead.copy: Mix camera audio, external microphones, and reference tracks in one place, with independent fader, pan, mute, and solo controls for each source. A master fader sets the stereo output level.

slides.title: Audio mixer
slides.caption: Multiple sources, channel controls, and the master output in one view.

lead.label: Explore the audio mixer

cards.title: Loudness and true-peak metering
cards.copy: Loudness metering uses ITU-R BS.1770, with EBU R128 and ATSC A/85 (Short Form) delivery profiles. Track loudness over time and check true-peak levels before delivery.

slides.title: Loudness
slides.caption: Track loudness throughout a take and compare it with your delivery target.

slides.title: Levels
slides.caption: Track true peak and RMS levels, with a history of the take.

cards.label: Explore loudness

cards.title: Stereo and spectrum analysis
cards.copy: Check stereo balance and phase correlation with the goniometer. Band and FFT spectrum analyzers plot signal level by frequency, and the oscilloscope displays waveform shape and transients.

slides.title: Goniometer and oscilloscope
slides.caption: Check stereo balance and inspect the shape of the waveform.

slides.title: Band and FFT spectrum
slides.caption: See frequency content by band or in fine detail.

slides.title: Six audio scopes
slides.caption: Every audio scope together in a single layout.

cards.label: Explore audio scopes

label: Recording & media
title: Recording and media management.
intro: Record clips with slate metadata and timecode, and save reference stills. Review takes in the Media Library and carry production details into DaVinci Resolve and Final Cut Pro.
summary: 10-bit HEVC and ProRes, external LTC, and slate-to-edit metadata.

lead.title: Digital slates and timecode
lead.copy: Attach production, scene, and take information to each capture using reusable digital slates. External LTC supplies the starting timecode for each recording.

slides.title: Digital slate
slides.caption: Keep production, scene, and take details with each capture.

lead.label: Explore slates

cards.title: 10-bit HEVC and ProRes recording
cards.copy: Record the camera input or the processed image in 10-bit HEVC or ProRes. Reference stills are saved alongside your clips in the Media Library for continuity checks.

slides.title: Capture controls
slides.caption: Snapshot, Slate, Record, and timecode sit together on the Status Toolbar.

cards.label: Explore recording and capture

cards.title: From slate to edit
cards.copy: The Media Library shows recorded takes with their slate details, notes, and ratings. Embedded production metadata carries into DaVinci Resolve and Final Cut Pro, reducing manual entry during editing.

slides.title: Media library
slides.caption: Review your takes with ratings, notes, and slate details close at hand.

cards.label: Explore the media library
